title: How would you estimate how many full-time wedding photographers the UK needs?
description: A step-by-step estimate for "How many full-time wedding photographers does the UK need?" with the approach, the maths and a sanity check.
hook: A short, two-step estimate that rewards thinking about the season: most weddings happen on summer weekends. Have a go at your own estimate before reading on.
body:
The question

How many full-time wedding photographers does the UK need?

The approach

Weddings per year ÷ weddings one photographer can shoot per year.

Tip: Name the assumption that matters most, so the interviewer knows where the estimate is most sensitive.

Step by step

  1. Weddings in the UK per year: 250k
  2. ÷ 25 weddings one photographer can do per year (mostly summer weekends)

That gives about 10k photographers.

Does it make sense?

Plenty of photographers also work part time, so the real number of people doing some weddings will be higher.
